# In-App Chat Prototype Context

## Goal

Build a working Sharity prototype for 1:1 user-to-user chat so borrowers and owners can coordinate pickup/return without relying on external WhatsApp/email fallback.

## MVP Scope

- 1:1 only.
- Conversation must be scoped to an item; claim linkage is optional but preferred when available.
- Text messages.
- System messages for claim lifecycle events.
- Conversation list.
- Thread view.
- Unread counter.
- Entry points from item/claim surfaces.

## Explicit Non-Scope

- No attachments.
- No typing indicators.
- No presence.
- No push/email notifications for v1 unless explicitly added later.
- No edit/delete messages.
- No group chats.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A signed-in user can start a conversation with an item owner.
- The owner and borrower can exchange messages in realtime through Convex queries.
- Both users can see a conversation list with last message preview.
- Unread count updates after receiving and reading messages.
- Claim lifecycle mutations can create system messages without weakening existing business rules.
- UI works under localized routes.
- Browser verification covers two users or clearly documents why that was not possible.
- Existing Sharry AI assistant route/module remains intact.

## Known Pitfalls

- `convex/chat.ts` name collision with Sharry AI assistant.
- Locale route pushes like `/chat/:id` can skip locale prefix from localized pages.
- Convex generated API types must be regenerated, not permanently edited by hand.
- Querying all conversations and filtering client-side is acceptable only for prototype scale; call it out if kept.
- Manual integration of multiple agent outputs can leave stale API module names.

pnpm convex codegen
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit

1 2 # Sharity (Vinh Loc Edition) 3 4 Платформа для sharing economy — люди одалживают и находят вещи для временного использования. 5 6 ## Концепция 7 8 **Проблема:** У людей есть вещи, которые редко используются, но могут быть полезны другим. 9 10 **Решение:** Платформа для временного шеринга вещей с системой заявок и календарём доступности. 11 12 ## Tech Stack 13 14 - **Frontend:** Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19) 15 - **Backend:** Convex (serverless database + functions) 16 - **Auth:** Clerk (OAuth, passwordless) 17 - **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui 18 - **Package Manager:** pnpm 19 - **Language:** TypeScript 5 20 21 ## Структура проекта 22 23 ``` 24 sharity-vinhloc/ 25 ├── app/ # Next.js App Router 26 │ ├── page.tsx # Главная (список вещей) 27 │ ├── layout.tsx # Root layout (Clerk + Convex providers) 28 │ ├── globals.css # Tailwind styles 29 │ └── ConvexClientProvider.tsx 30 ├── components/ # React компоненты 31 │ ├── ui/ # shadcn компоненты 32 │ │ ├── button.tsx 33 │ │ ├── calendar.tsx 34 │ │ ├── card.tsx 35 │ │ ├── dialog.tsx 36 │ │ ├── file-upload.tsx 37 │ │ └── ... 38 │ ├── item-card.tsx # Карточка вещи 39 │ ├── item-form.tsx # Форма добавления/редактирования 40 │ ├── item-list.tsx # Список вещей 41 │ ├── my-item-card.tsx # Карточка своей вещи (с claims) 42 │ ├── my-items-list.tsx # Список своих вещей 43 │ ├── claim-button.tsx # Кнопка заявки 44 │ └── claim-item-back.tsx # Возврат вещи 45 ├── convex/ # Convex backend 46 │ ├── schema.ts # Database schema 47 │ ├── items.ts # Queries & mutations 48 │ ├── auth.config.ts # Clerk integration 49 │ └── _generated/ # Auto-generated types 50 ├── hooks/ # Custom hooks 51 │ ├── use-as-ref.ts 52 │ ├── use-isomorphic-layout-effect.ts 53 │ └── use-lazy-ref.ts 54 ├── lib/ # Утилиты 55 │ └── utils.ts # cn() helper 56 ├── public/ # Статика 57 └── .claude/ # Claude Code конфиг 58 └── handoff/ # Handoff файлы 59 ``` 60 61 ## Модель данных (Convex Schema) 62 63 ### Item (Вещь) 64 ```typescript 65 items: defineTable({ 66 name: v.string(), 67 description: v.optional(v.string()), 68 ownerId: v.string(), // Clerk user ID 69 imageStorageIds: v.optional(v.array(v.id("_storage"))), 70 }) 71 ``` 72 73 ### Claim (Заявка) 74 ```typescript 75 claims: defineTable({ 76 itemId: v.id("items"), 77 claimerId: v.string(), // Clerk user ID 78 status: v.union( 79 v.literal("pending"), 80 v.literal("approved"), 81 v.literal("rejected"), 82 ), 83 startDate: v.number(), // timestamp 84 endDate: v.number(), // timestamp 85 }) 86 .index("by_item", ["itemId"]) 87 .index("by_claimer", ["claimerId"]) 88 ``` 89 90 ## Convex Functions (convex/items.ts) 91 92 ### Queries 93 - `get` — Получить все доступные вещи (исключая свои) 94 - `getMyItems` — Получить свои вещи + взятые на время 95 - `getClaims` — Получить заявки на вещь (только владелец) 96 - `getAvailability` — Получить занятые периоды для календаря 97 98 ### Mutations 99 - `create` — Создать вещь 100 - `update` — Обновить вещь (только владелец) 101 - `deleteItem` — Удалить вещь (только владелец) 102 - `requestItem` — Создать заявку на вещь 103 - `approveClaim` — Одобрить заявку (только владелец) 104 - `rejectClaim` — Отклонить заявку (только владелец) 105 - `cancelClaim` — Отменить свою заявку 106 - `generateUploadUrl` — URL для загрузки изображений 107 108 ## Команды 109 110 ```bash 111 # Разработка 112 pnpm dev # Запуск Next.js dev сервера 113 pnpm convex:dev # Запуск Convex dev (в отдельном терминале) 114 # или: pnpm convex dev 115 116 # Сборка 117 pnpm build # Production build 118 pnpm start # Start production server 119 120 # Качество кода 121 pnpm lint # ESLint 122 pnpm format # Biome formatter 123 124 # Evals (Sharry AI assistant) 125 ./scripts/run-evals.sh # Run promptfoo evals (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) 126 pnpm eval # Same via pnpm 127 pnpm eval:view # Run + open results web UI 128 ``` 129 130 ## Environment Variables 131 132 ```env 133 # Convex 134 CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT= # team:project identifier 135 CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT_KEY= # для production 136 NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL= # https://xxx.convex.cloud 137 138 # Clerk 139 NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= 140 CLERK_SECRET_KEY= 141 CLERK_ISSUER_URL= # для Convex auth 142 ``` 143 144 ## Authentication Flow 145 146 1. **Clerk** handles authentication (SignIn/SignUp modal) 147 2. **Convex** validates JWT tokens via `auth.config.ts` 148 3. User ID доступен через `ctx.auth.getUserIdentity().subject` 149 150 ```typescript 151 // В Convex function 152 const identity = await ctx.auth.getUserIdentity(); 153 if (!identity) throw new Error("Unauthenticated"); 154 const userId = identity.subject; 155 ``` 156 157 ## Key Patterns 158 159 ### Convex + Clerk Setup 160 ```tsx 161 // app/layout.tsx 162 163 164 {children} 165 166 167 ``` 168 169 ### Convex Client Provider 170 ```tsx 171 // app/ConvexClientProvider.tsx 172 "use client"; 173 import { ConvexProviderWithClerk } from "convex/react-clerk"; 174 import { useAuth } from "@clerk/nextjs"; 175 ``` 176 177 ### Using Convex in Components 178 ```tsx 179 import { useQuery, useMutation } from "convex/react"; 180 import { api } from "@/convex/_generated/api"; 181 182 const items = useQuery(api.items.get); 183 const createItem = useMutation(api.items.create); 184 ``` 185 186 ## Code Style (Vinhloc's Patterns) 187 188 ### Форматирование 189 - **Formatter:** Biome (`pnpm format`) 190 - **Кавычки:** Двойные `"string"` 191 - **Точки с запятой:** Да, всегда 192 - **Отступы:** Tabs 193 - **Типы:** Строгий TypeScript, никаких `any` 194 195 ### Naming Conventions 196 197 ```typescript 198 // Файлы 199 ComponentName.tsx // PascalCase для компонентов 200 kebab-case.tsx // kebab-case для утилит 201 components/lease/ // kebab-case для папок 202 203 // Переменные и функции 204 const isFlipped = true; // is* для boolean 205 const canRate = checkPermission(); // can* для проверок 206 const pickedUpAt = Date.now(); // *At для timestamps 207 208 // Типы 209 interface ItemCardProps { } // *Props для props 210 type LeaseActivityEvent = { } // PascalCase для типов 211 212 // Константы 213 const ONE_HOUR_MS = 3600000; // UPPER_SNAKE_CASE 214 ``` 215 216 ### Convex Functions Pattern 217 218 ```typescript 219 export const functionName = mutation({ 220 args: { id: v.id("items") }, 221 handler: async (ctx, args) => { 222 // 1. Auth check 223 const identity = await ctx.auth.getUserIdentity(); 224 if (!identity) throw new Error("Unauthenticated"); 225 226 // 2. Fetch data 227 const item = await ctx.db.get(args.id); 228 if (!item) throw new Error("Item not found"); 229 230 // 3. Authorization 231 if (item.ownerId !== identity.subject) { 232 throw new Error("Unauthorized"); 233 } 234 235 // 4. Business logic + activity trail 236 await ctx.db.insert("item_activity", { 237 itemId: args.id, 238 type: "item_updated", 239 actorId: identity.subject, 240 createdAt: Date.now(), 241 }); 242 243 // 5. Return result 244 return { success: true }; 245 }, 246 }); 247 ``` 248 249 ### React Component Pattern 250 251 ```typescript 252 "use client"; 253 254 import { useMutation, useQuery } from "convex/react"; 255 import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from "react"; 256 257 interface ComponentProps { 258 item: Doc<"items">; 259 } 260 261 export function ComponentName({ item }: ComponentProps) { 262 // 1. Hooks at top 263 const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false); 264 const data = useQuery(api.items.get); 265 const mutate = useMutation(api.items.update); 266 267 // 2. Derived state with useMemo 268 const canEdit = useMemo(() => /* ... */, [deps]); 269 270 // 3. Handlers with useCallback 271 const handleClick = useCallback(async () => { 272 setIsLoading(true); 273 try { 274 await mutate({ id: item._id }); 275 } finally { 276 setIsLoading(false); 277 } 278 }, [mutate, item._id]); 279 280 // 4. Early returns for guards 281 if (!data) return ; 282 283 // 5. JSX 284 return
...
; 285 } 286 ``` 287 288 ### Activity Trail Pattern 289 290 Каждая мутация создаёт запись в activity таблице — это source of truth: 291 292 ```typescript 293 // В mutation 294 await ctx.db.insert("lease_activity", { 295 itemId: args.itemId, 296 claimId: claim._id, 297 type: "lease_approved", 298 actorId: identity.subject, 299 createdAt: Date.now(), 300 }); 301 302 // В компоненте — derive state from events 303 const status = useMemo(() => { 304 const lastEvent = leaseEvents[leaseEvents.length - 1]; 305 return lastEvent?.type ?? # Convex Context

## Important Files

- `convex/schema.ts` defines all database tables.
- `convex/items.ts` owns item, claim, lease lifecycle, pickup/return, and many scheduler hooks.
- `convex/chat.ts` is Sharry AI assistant context, so user-to-user chat must use another module name.
- `convex/users.ts` stores user profiles and optional contacts.
- `convex/notifications.ts`, `convex/emails.ts`, `convex/emailSend.ts`, and `convex/emailTemplates/*` handle notifications and outbound email.
- `convex/_generated/*` is generated by Convex and should not be manually maintained.

## Patterns

- Auth first:
  ```ts
  const identity = await ctx.auth.getUserIdentity();
  if (!identity) throw new Error("Unauthenticated");
  const userId = identity.subject;
  ```
- Fetch docs before authorization decisions.
- Only owners can approve/reject claims.
- Claimers cannot request their own items.
- Approved claim windows cannot overlap.
- Activity tables are source-of-truth for lifecycle derivation where the local module uses them.

## In-App Messaging Notes

- Prefer `conversations`, `conversation_messages`, and `conversation_reads` over overloading existing AI chat tables.
- Conversations should be scoped to an `itemId` and optionally a `claimId`.
- `participantIds` should be sorted before lookup.
- Read state belongs in a per-user table rather than mutating every message.
- Use internal helpers for lifecycle system messages from claim mutations.

## Tooling

`pnpm convex codegen` can fail under unsupported local Node versions. If that happens, do not hide it; either run with a supported Node runtime or record the blocker.

**Not captured.** Blocker is environmental, not patch-induced: the worktree has no `.env.local`, so neither Convex (`CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL`) nor Clerk (`CLERK_SECRET_KEY`, `E2E_USER_A_EMAIL`, `E2E_USER_B_EMAIL`) credentials are present, and `playwright/.auth/` does not exist. 1. **Hand-edited `convex/_generated/api.d.ts`** — added `messaging` import + `typeof messaging` line because `pnpm convex codegen` requires `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT` and that variable is not present in this worktree. 6. **No Playwright regression spec for chat** added; runbook flow (User B starts chat, User A sees unread, replies, etc.) is unexecuted.
